class: Test state shared with the owner's real state, through a path the isolation did not know
symptom: 29 September: 'First Name = Yash R.' appeared in the owner's real data/profile_answers.json, written by a test run; the agent then read it back, and a test began to fail.
root_cause: conftest redirected module paths written 'data/...' only; profile_setup.ANSWERS_PATH is the full path (config.DATA_DIR / ...), and page_agent read the same file through a path built inside a function, so a test's learned answer went to the owner's file and was read back from it.
why_tests_missed: The isolation check covered relative data/ paths; nothing checked full paths under data/ or that reader and writer used one path.
fix: conftest redirects full-path module attributes under data/ as well (the profile stays readable) and loads modules that name them through DATA_DIR; page_agent reads the saved answers through profile_setup.ANSWERS_PATH. The stray entry was removed from the owner's file (backup kept locally).
prevention: Name each data file in one place, and have the test setup redirect by where a path points, not by how it is spelled; check the owner's files are byte-identical after a full test run.
